propositions: Implemented a portable Python public-API surface drift gate that snapshots the current public surface into a committed baseline and fails on any diff, using pure-stdlib introspection (inspect/importlib) with no new dependencies.
The gate is wired as a test-linked operation that runs under 'make test' with no CI-provider dependency, modeled on the existing config-key drift gate (scripts/gen_config_reference.py).
Removed the hardcoded-subset assertions from test_reuse_surface_doc.py and subsumed them with automatic surface checks, eliminating the manual lockstep maintenance burden.

The source-of-truth rule captures each module's public members via __all__ when defined, else owned non-underscore attributes, pinning callable parameter lists, class bases/dataclass fields, public-method signatures, and values of immutable constants.
RED→GREEN drift detection is proven: removing a public symbol causes 'python scripts/gen_api_surface.py --check' to exit 1 with clear drift reporting; restoring returns exit 0.
